alignments.note: Article of the adverbial phrase; the ASV writes no determiner in Finally (rule 23).
The ASV writes no connective here; Finally answers to the noun.
Supplied subject pronoun ye is a helper on the substantival quantifier (rule 7); head on all, which realizes the lexeme (rule 17).
Verbless clause with adjectival predicates: the supplied copula rides with the first predicate adjective, discontinuously (rules 53, 15). Giving be to the expressed subject pantes remains defensible.

One compound adjective rendered by a three-word English phrase; the head goes to *loving*, the word glossing the compound's own phil- element, as 2PE.1.7 and TIT.1.8 have it. The adelph- modifier is what *brethren* renders, and the corpus has twice declined to head it there.
